title: Fix step instructions do not show the fix-note heading or triage-rule format
body:
What happened: A fixer agent got a fix step with the instructions to write a note at .warden/fixes/<date>-<task>.md and add a triage rule. The instructions give no format for either. The agent searched, did not find a schema, and guessed. warden done then rejected the hand-in.

What I expected: The fix step instructions (or the FixOutput schema text) show the required note heading and the triage rule fields (pattern, flags, and the rest), so the first hand-in is accepted.

Steps: 1. Get a ticket into a fix step with an OPS verdict. 2. Give the context to the fixer agent. 3. Fixer writes a note and a rule without knowing the format. 4. warden done rejects it.

Evidence: accepted false. Errors: the note has a missing heading "# Fix <YYYY-MM-DD> PG-301"; triage-rules.json rules[0].flags must be "" or "i", got undefined; rules[0].pattern must be a string, got undefined.
note: Fixed. The fix step shows a complete fix note and rule example.
